title: Term Life Insurance Rate Manual: Installment After the Accidental Death Rider Ends
content:
**Term Life Insurance.** When the accidental death rider ends at the anniversary on which the insured's anniversary age reaches the product's accidental death rider expiry age, the installment after the accidental death rider ends is set from the premium components on record:

1. **Ages and years.** The insured's issue age is the whole years from the date of birth to the issue date on record; the anniversary age, the whole years from the date of birth to the most recent policy anniversary on or before today; the policy years completed, the whole years from the issue date to today.
2. **Face premium.** The band measurement face is the face amount on record alone; the band factor is 1.00; the face premium is the face amount on record divided by 1,000, times the rate per 1,000 on record, times the band factor, rounded to the cent.
3. **Policy fee.** The fee before sharing is set by the face amount on record — the product's annual policy fee less 10.00 below 250000, less 20.00 at 1000000 or more, and the product's annual policy fee from 250000 up to 1000000. The long-standing fee concession is nothing and the policy fee share is the whole fee. The policy fee is the fee before sharing less the concession, never below nothing, times the share, rounded to the cent.
4. **Accidental death charge.** None: the rider having been removed, the installment carries no accidental death charge, and none of the rider rates that applied while it was attached (1.08 per 1,000 at anniversary ages 60 through 69, that is 60 or more and below 70; 0.84 per 1,000 below 45; the product's rate otherwise) enters it.
5. **Children's term charge.** The unit rate is 5.00 when 11 or more units are on record, 5.50 when 5 through 10, and the product's children's term rate per unit below 5; the charge is the units on record times the unit rate.
6. **Waiver charge.** The waiver rate is 0.14 at issue age 45 or more, 0.09 below 35, and 0.11 from 35 through 44. The waiver charge base is the face premium plus the accidental death charge plus the children's term charge at issue age 40 or more, the face premium plus the accidental death charge at 30 through 39, and the face premium alone below 30. When the waiver of premium rider is attached on record the waiver charge is the rate times the base, rounded to the cent; otherwise there is none.
7. **Annual premium.** The face premium plus the policy fee, the accidental death charge, the children's term charge and the waiver charge.
8. **Installment.** The annual premium times the modal factor of the premium mode on record (the product's quarterly factor for quarterly, monthly bank-draft factor for monthly bank draft, semiannual factor for semiannual, annual factor for annual), rounded to the cent.

### Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

Ashgrove Level Term 15 in semiannual mode; face on record 300000; rate per 1,000 on record 1.80; issue age 33; waiver rider attached; no children's units.

| Component | Amount |
|---|---|
| Face premium: 300 times 1.80 times 1.00 | 540.00 |
| Policy fee: 70.00, no concession, whole fee | 70.00 |
| Accidental death charge | 0.00 |
| Waiver charge: 0.09 times (540.00 plus 0.00) | 48.60 |
| Annual premium | 658.60 |
| Installment: 658.60 times 0.52, rounded | 342.47 |
